posts.title: Image Storage

posts.title: 251209_Typing_Test
posts.description: I have created a way to use the 10 key as a keyboard using AutoKey. This is like the way the old cell phones were set up. The difference is everything is two keys for each letter. AI was very useful in the Python program I'm using on Windows at work. The mapping is: 87, 88, 89 = a, b, c 97, 98, 99 = d, e, f 44, 45, 46 = g, h, i 54, 55, 56 = j, k, l 64, 65, 66 = m, n, o 11, 12, 13, 14 = p, q, r, s
